content.text:
I built the dashboard as a single `index.html`. I tested it in headless Chrome at 1440px and 390px, and the scripted checks passed with no console errors.

**Layout**
- **Navigation:** at desktop width, a dark sidebar shows the company name and the seven items, with Overview marked as the current page. Below 1024px it turns into a drawer behind a menu button. The drawer can be closed with Escape, the close button or a tap outside, and keyboard focus stays inside it while it's open.
- **Top bar:** the "Sales & Operations" title, "October 2026 compared with September 2026", the search field and Mara Kim with "MK" initials. On phones the name and role are only read out by screen readers, and the initials stay visible.
- **KPI cards:** each card shows the change against September with an arrow and the change in text, so it doesn't rely on color. The refund rate's −0.3 points is shown in green, because a decrease is good.
- **Revenue chart:** stacked bars split by channel, drawn as inline SVG. A control switches between All channels, Online only and Cafés only, and the y-axis rescales for each view. The exact values appear on mouse hover, on tap, or when moving between months with the arrow keys. A "View data table" link opens the same figures as a table.
- **Category and inventory:** category shares are shown as bars measured against 100%, so their lengths match the true shares. Inventory is sorted with the lowest stock first. Brazil Cerrado (3 days) and Ethiopia Guji (6 days) are flagged with a warning icon and "Reorder needed", and each bar has a marker at the 7-day reorder point.
- **Café table:** sortable on every column, in both directions, by mouse or keyboard. On phones it scrolls sideways and the café name column stays fixed.
- **Recent orders:** the four statuses differ by icon and wording, not just color. Pending also has a dashed outline. On phones each order becomes a two-line row.

**Things I added that you didn't ask for**
- **Search filters the page:** typing filters the café, product and order tables and shows how many rows match. It ignores accents, so "tomas" finds Tomás. Pressing "/" jumps to the search field and Escape clears it.
- **Figures worked out from your data:** these are exact calculations, not new data. They are:
  - the café/online split under the KPI cards, such as Online $83,000, which is $184,320 minus the cafés' $101,320;
  - the café totals in the table subtitle;
  - one-line summaries such as "October was the strongest month of the year, ahead of December's $176k".

  Remove these if you want only the figures you supplied.

**Limitations**
- The nav items have no other pages behind them. Orders and Products scroll to their sections on this page; Customers, Inventory, Reports and Settings do nothing yet.
- If Google Fonts can't load (for example, offline), the page falls back to system fonts. It still works.
- The 390px check ran in a 390px-wide frame, because headless Chrome won't open a window that narrow; I haven't tested on a real phone.
